about: The manuals' cockpit pictures (modern-iaf/docs/manuals.md §4): per cockpit (the Sufa and the Barak share the F-16's, so one set of pictures serves both manuals) a cold start-up mission (and legends: nose where every console's legends read toward the nose, so a console's picture has the nose on top) and the shots, each the 3D cockpit's controls (node names of the cockpit's control table) the head turns to. modern-iaf/tests/_manual_shots.gd takes pictures/<cockpit>/<shot>.jpg and writes pictures/<cockpit>/marks.json, where each control sits in its picture; the Typst build draws the numbers and arrows from that.
